day, but many people wonder: what is the difference between the two? (2) To start with, the
butterfat content is much higher in ice cream than it is in gelato, making the Italian treat a
wiser decision for people looking to make healthier choices. (3) Additionally, the mixing
process, which adds less air to the frozen treat, makes gelato denser than ice cream.
(4) Finally, gelato is served 10 to 15 degrees warmer than ice cream, which enhances the
texture and flavor of the gelato, and allow it to melt more quickly.
